en: A loud, unpleasant sound; or any sound.
ex: The noise from the street kept me awake.
街上的噪音讓我睡不著。

en: Making a lot of loud noise.
ex: The classroom was very noisy before the teacher came.
老師來之前，教室非常吵。

en: Twelve o'clock in the middle of the day.
ex: We usually have lunch at noon.
我們通常中午吃午餐。

en: The direction on your left when you face the sunrise; or the part of a place in that direction.
ex: The compass needle always points north.
指南針的指針總是指向北方。

en: The part of your face above your mouth that you use to breathe and smell with.
ex: He has a cold, so his nose is red.
他感冒了，所以鼻子紅紅的。

en: Used to make a verb or statement negative.
ex: I do not like to get up early.
我不喜歡早起。

en: A short piece of writing to help you remember something; or to pay attention to something; or a musical sound.
ex: Please take notes during the lecture.
上課時請做筆記。

en: Not anything; no thing.
ex: There is nothing in the box.
盒子裡什麼也沒有。

en: To see or become aware of something; or a written or printed announcement.
ex: Did you notice the new sign on the door?
你有注意到門上的新標示嗎？

en: At the present time; at this moment.
ex: I am busy now; please call me back later.
我現在很忙，請待會再回電給我。

en: A word or symbol used for counting; or a telephone number; or a quantity.
ex: What's your telephone number?
你的電話號碼是多少？

en: A person whose job is to take care of sick people in a hospital; or to look after someone who is ill.
ex: The nurse took my temperature and gave me some medicine.
護理師幫我量了體溫並給我一些藥。

en: Used to show agreement or that something is acceptable; or healthy and not hurt.
ex: Is it OK if I sit here?
我坐這裡可以嗎？

en: Used to show that something belongs to someone; or is part of something; or to show a source.
ex: This is a photo of my family.
這是我家人的一張照片。

en: Not turned on; or away from a place; or no longer happening; or free from work.
ex: Please turn off the lights when you leave.
離開時請關燈。

en: A room or building where people work at desks; or a position of authority.
ex: My father goes to the office by train.
我爸爸搭火車去辦公室。

en: A person who has an important position in an organization, the army or the government.
ex: The police officer asked for my name and address.
警察問了我的姓名和地址。

en: Many times; in many cases.
ex: I often go to the library after school.
我放學後常去圖書館。

en: A thick liquid made from plants or found under the ground, used for cooking or as fuel; or to put oil on something.
ex: Heat some oil in the pan before you fry the eggs.
煎蛋之前先在鍋裡加熱一些油。

en: Having lived for a long time; or not new; or of a certain age.
ex: My grandfather is eighty years old.
我祖父八十歲了。

en: Touching or supported by a surface; or working or switched on; or about a subject.
ex: The book is on the table.
書在桌子上。

en: One time only; or at some time in the past; or as soon as.
ex: I go swimming once a week.
我一星期去游泳一次。

en: Connected to the internet; or available or done on the internet.
ex: She bought a new bag online.
她在網路上買了一個新包包。

en: Not more than; or the one and no others; or but.
ex: She is the only girl in the class.
她是班上唯一的女生。

en: Not closed or covered; or to move something so that people can go in; or to begin.
ex: Please open the window; it is hot in here.
請把窗戶打開，這裡很熱。

en: Used to show a choice between two or more things; or to mean 'if not'.
ex: Would you like tea or coffee?
你要茶還是咖啡？

en: A round, sweet fruit with a thick orange skin; or a bright color between red and yellow.
ex: I drink a glass of orange juice every morning.
我每天早上喝一杯柳橙汁。

en: To ask for food in a restaurant or goods in a shop; or the way things are arranged; or to tell someone what to do.
ex: I'd like to order a pizza and a salad.
我想點一個披薩和一份沙拉。

en: Different from the one already mentioned; or more; or the second of two.
ex: One of the boys is tall; the other is short.
其中一個男孩很高，另一個很矮。

en: Away from the inside of a place; or no longer burning or in fashion; or not at home.
ex: She went out to play in the garden.
她出去花園裡玩。

en: The outer part of something; or not in a building; or in the open air.
ex: It's warm outside, so let's play in the yard.
外面很暖和，我們去院子玩吧。

en: Above something; or across something; or finished; or more than.
ex: The plane flew over the mountains.
飛機飛過了群山。

en: Belonging to a particular person; or to have something as your property.
ex: She has her own room in the house.
她在家裡有自己的房間。

en: Used after a number to show the time by the clock.
ex: The class starts at eight o'clock.
課在八點開始。

en: To put things into a bag or box to take them somewhere; or a group of things packed together.
ex: I need to pack my bags for the trip.
我需要為旅行打包行李。

en: Something wrapped in paper or put in a box to be sent by post; or a set of things sold together.
ex: A package arrived for you this morning.
今天早上有一個包裹寄給你。

en: One side of a piece of paper in a book; or a web page; or to call someone by speaker.
ex: Please open your books to page twenty.
請把書翻到第二十頁。

en: A colored liquid you put on a surface; or to cover a surface with color; or to make a picture with paint.
ex: She painted the walls of her room yellow.
她把房間的牆壁漆成黃色。

en: Two things of the same kind that are used together; or two people together; or to join two things.
ex: I bought a new pair of shoes yesterday.
我昨天買了一雙新鞋。

en: A piece of clothing that covers your legs and has two parts; (British) underwear.
ex: He put on his pants and went to school.
他穿上褲子就去上學了。
